evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#collects completion and cancellation until the whole batch is terminal, then delivers once
cases.detail: Partial worker completion remains collecting; success, failure and cancellation all count.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#requires a deferred verifier to become terminal before releasing the team bundle
cases.detail: Workers are held until the deferred verifier has a terminal record.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#reports a missing accepted worker without creating a phantom completion or delivery
cases.detail: Missing expected worker is reported as missing; no completion or delivery is invented.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#does not infer delivery from immediate worker text and requires explicit delivery state
cases.detail: A created-and-ended run with final text remains delivery-pending until registry delivery reaches delivered.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#fences a stale parent generation and leaves the durable delivery intent pending
cases.detail: All batch members must share the spawn-time requester sessionId, and the active parent turn must match it.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#keeps independent batches isolated and fences mixed worker generations
tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#keeps one consolidated delivery per orchestration across multiple terminal batches
cases.detail: mixed generations are partial; separately consistent batches remain isolated and emit one bundle section each.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#keeps suspended delivery intent and resumes it only in the pinned parent generation
cases.detail: Suspension retains the outbox payload; a stale parent cannot lease it and a matching active turn can.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#does not split a bounded batch into a partial prompt after a crash and replay
cases.detail: Persisted in-progress/delivered delivery state prevents a second lease after JSON reload and after real Electron/Gateway restart.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#never retries a team prompt once any member has started or completed delivery
cases.detail: Once any item has begun or completed delivery, no second consolidated prompt is exposed for that batch.

evidence: tests/unit/long-session-completion-continuation.test.ts#bounds worker references and refuses consolidated delivery above the batch limit
cases.detail: Receipts expose at most 64 worker refs; oversized batches are partial and are not delivered as a consolidated prompt.
The real Host/Gateway journey stops the accepted child and records a terminal failed batch rather than a phantom success.

C1 invalidates deleted/archived generations and A2 fences archive/delete mutation windows; no active parent turn can lease an invalidated generation. Pause is represented by the absence of a matching active run, so delivery intent stays pending.
